elements.name: Pisces
elements.text: Pisces: dreams and empathy, a receptive depth that dissolves the boundary between self and other.

elements.name: Moon face
elements.text: The face in the moon: our hidden, intimate side, watching from stillness as the night deepens.

elements.name: Twin fish riders
elements.text: Twin figures riding mirrored fish: the two equal, opposing halves of Pisces, guided toward our depths.

rounds.text: The Moon asks us to look closely at our hidden, intimate side, where the senses sharpen and {b2} takes on a deeper, more magical dimension. It resonates with Pisces, the zodiac's final and most inwardly guided sign, where daily life and spirit meet, echoed in the two fish swimming in opposite directions. Ruled by Neptune, planet of {b1}, this card invites us into the unknown to face repeating patterns and grow.
